name: voice_report
description: Read or dismiss a report from a finished child agent. A voice session never blocks its turn waiting for a child: when a child finishes, its last message (or last error) is saved as a report, and the next spoken turn carries one short system note listing the waiting reports. Answer the user first and offer the reports in one sentence; call this tool with action='read' only after the user says yes. `read` returns the report body and marks it read; `dismiss` drops it without returning the body. Reports are scoped to this coordinator: an id from another session is refused. Verify the id against the waiting-reports note rather than guessing one.

action.description: 'read' returns the report body and marks the report read; 'dismiss' marks it dismissed without returning the body. Use 'read' only after the user agrees to hear it.

report_id.description: Report id exactly as shown in the waiting-reports note (32 hex characters). Ids are validated against this coordinator's reports; nothing is guessed.
